entries.60ff9196da307526: This business manufactures and sells compound feed, mainly made from grains, for poultry, pigs, cattle, fish and others. It also buys and sells livestock products produced by its customers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥43,669 million. Feed is manufactured at the Kobe, Mihara, Kagoshima, Hachinohe and Sakaide plants, and part of the compound feed for cattle is contracted for manufacture to affiliate Michinoku Shiryo Co., Ltd.
entries.b22b5dc86b62a98e: This is a business in which Towa Chikusan Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary, produces and sells livestock products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,910 million. Towa Chikusan Co., Ltd. has poultry and pig farming facilities at its farms in Shimabara City, Nagasaki Prefecture, and other locations.

entries.da4f4fe3765bec5d: This is a compound feed manufacturer with its head office in Higashinada Ward, Kobe, and the group consists of the company, 1 consolidated subsidiary and 1 affiliate.
